report.summary: Transport needs for P-D011 (34F, commercial HDHP, no transport benefit). Patient reports no car but uses the Brown Line and finds it easy; screener transportation answer "no" (no identified problem). Home tract 17031062000 has strong transit access (88 stops within 800 m, 47.6% no-vehicle households). No upcoming appointments to verify trip feasibility. Eligible/conditional options: RideWell Medical Transport (bookable with address + insurance, but no transport benefit and unmet deductible means likely out-of-pocket cost) and ADA Paratransit (only if a disability is certified; up to 21 days). Ineligible: Medicaid Ride Line (commercial insurance), Senior Shuttle West (age 60+, patient is 34).
